scope: Tracked and nonignored working-tree dependency manifests, lockfiles, container build contexts, Compose/Helm deployments, IaC providers, CI/actions/tool installers, source-distributed components and integration adapters. No claim of exhaustive equivalence for every possible third-party library or vulnerability-free/GPU-ready runtime.

findings.decision: llama.cpp, whisper.cpp and vLLM use digest-pinned upstream images without VideoQ rebuilding or republishing them.

Use maintained Homebrew bottles by default. Verified arm64_sequoia bottle checksum and whisper-server binary; native macOS execution not performed. Retain optional source submodule for source experiments or unsupported platforms.

Published @yukiharada1228/langchain-postgres is an unofficial Python-to-TypeScript port, not a VideoQ in-repo build. Official @langchain/pgvector 0.1.0 exports PGVectorStore without PGEngine or metadataColumns. Its filters target JSON metadata; VideoQ filters user_id and video_id relational columns. A replacement requires a deliberate adapter/schema and authorization-isolation migration, not an import rename. No replacement applied in this audit.

Published scene-otsu 0.1.5 hardcodes OpenAI client creation and tiktoken model lookup in its embedder and recomputes means for every Otsu candidate. Local adapter uses validated hosted/private embedding routes, batched dimension checks, cumulative sums, bounded memory and shared timestamps. Package alone is not a behavior-preserving replacement. Upstream extension or adapter/performance regression work remains a candidate.

Local/onprem worker uses Debian/Alpine FFmpeg packages. Lambda and transcription gateway use checksum-pinned BtbN prebuilt LGPL FFmpeg, linked by FFmpeg official download page. No FFmpeg source compilation. BtbN is an upstream-referenced third-party distributor rather than an FFmpeg-project-owned binary.

PostgreSQL/pgvector, Garage, ElasticMQ, Caddy and nginx use publisher images. Operations Dockerfile is read as an upstream image reference by backup/restore scripts, not built. Garage initialization/migration is application configuration using boto3.

Node, Python, Lambda, uv, Helm, kind, npm, pip, wrangler, Playwright, Terraform providers and external Actions are published distributions. Custom scripts orchestrate VideoQ builds/deployments and checksum verification; they do not implement substitute runtimes.

All external npm lock resolutions use npm registry tarballs; Python external sources are PyPI and official PyTorch CPU index. Workspace links are VideoQ application code. No git/URL/path override replacing an external package found.

Overrides select published upstream releases rather than patched/forked source. They include security floors and tool compatibility constraints. Inventory recorded; removal or version upgrades are not proven safe by source provenance review and were not applied.

Authentication uses Better Auth official plugins/helpers, signing uses aws4fetch, Python storage/queue uses boto3, DB uses pg/psycopg, browser transcoding uses mediabunny, ASR gateway uses FastAPI/Silero/ONNX/Hugging Face. Authorization, quotas, transactional index replacement, scene/citation timing, checkpoints and model checksums remain VideoQ policy. No generic replacement established that preserves these requirements.

Adapted source-distributed shadcn/Digital Agency components remain application UI. Corrected copied notice which incorrectly described VideoQ itself as the upstream registry and claimed a nonexistent design-system submodule. Required third-party notices preserved.
Uses registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws and registry.terraform.io/openai/openai. Terraform modules/resources are VideoQ infrastructure configuration, not provider forks.
Historical reports and retired-reference examples are evidence, not active dependency declarations; not rewritten to falsely imply old runs used new upstream artifacts.

Follow-up found the original audit omitted a native Mac llama.cpp setup. Added Homebrew llama-server recipe with separate chat/embedding processes, chart-pinned model identities, Metal offload request and matching API/worker environment. Homebrew ships llama-server; native Mac/Metal acceptance has not been performed.

Added digest-pinned upstream ROCm image, AMD resource validation, supplemental group configuration, full/speech-only GPU profiles and vendor-isolated CI scans. The exact stock ROCm image lacks usable audio decoders: AMD speech gets locked public soundfile/CFFI runtime packages via a local gateway init container and read-only volume, without copying CPU PyTorch/NumPy, rebuilding vLLM or using serving-time pip/network. Non-root isolated WAV decoding passed with the locked payload. GPU model execution remains unverified on the undecided target hardware.

Enabled/disabled roles own only their own resources. Each chat/embedding role can override its backend and GPU vendor; speech can override its GPU vendor. All 64 external/CPU/CUDA/ROCm role combinations pass chart rendering checks. Existing speech services can choose their own model alias and credential, including via Lambda SSM without overriding explicit environment variables. Bundled codecs can be retired with audioCodecs=upstream. Native Mac/physical GPU inference remains subject to hardware acceptance.

security.policy: Raw reports remain retained. CUDA uses only its existing scoped kernel-header OpenVEX. CPU whisper.cpp has a separate 2026-10-27 assessment for two exact image/header inventories and explicit CVE IDs, applied only after flattened-image inventory verification. ROCm has no exemption. Unknown CVEs, other packages or inventory changes fail validation.
security.limits: All four VideoQ-owned image scans cover local amd64 builds. CPU engine package scans cover Linux amd64 and arm64. GPU-image scans cover amd64 images. These scans do not establish ARM or GPU inference, macOS execution or the complete Kubernetes/application lifecycle.
security.cpuCi: Independent 2-engine × 2-architecture matrix; remote registry source and explicit platform; report architecture and requested digest checked; failed-gate JSON retained.

whisperAssessmentControl.meaning: Removing one explicit CVE assessment causes that CVE to remain outstanding and the unchanged gate to fail.
